title: Otyughs
content:
The Eater of Filth ([[13.12]]) is an otyugh.

The young of an otyugh lie quiescent within it. If it ever goes hungry for too long, they awake and devour their parent. These young will then roam the landscape looking for another source of food, causing great destruction.
